# Agentic Video Foundry

Agentic Video Foundry is an open-source Agent Skill that turns one clear request into a short video people can review, publish, and keep editing. It creates a goal brief, storyboard, visual guide, independent prototype, narration, music, sound effects, captions, and final delivery checks.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://video.zzh.app/
- Chinese website: https://video.zzh.app/zh/
- Source repository: https://github.com/ZetaZeroHub/agentic-video-foundry
- Skill entrypoint: https://github.com/ZetaZeroHub/agentic-video-foundry/blob/main/skills/agentic-video-foundry/SKILL.md
- License: https://github.com/ZetaZeroHub/agentic-video-foundry/blob/main/LICENSE

## Install

`npx skills add ZetaZeroHub/agentic-video-foundry@agentic-video-foundry -g -y`

## Verified design boundaries

- It starts by defining the audience, publishing platform, and duration.
- The approved narration timing drives scenes and complete caption lines.
- API keys remain in the OS keychain or environment variables.
- Paid and private media is not distributed through Git history.
- Completion requires a full visual and audio review plus technical checks.
- Audio generation can route ElevenLabs or Volcengine for narration, voice auditions, music, and sound effects; captions are aligned to generated audio timestamps.
- Target agent environments include Codex, Claude Code, Trae, Gemini CLI, Kimi Code, MiniMax, WorkBuddy, Manus, and other tools that can load Agent Skills or repository instructions.
